design_archetype.description: Combines rich dark forest green textures, warm earthy golden highlights, clean editorial typography, and high-density data grids to convey trust, scientific rigour, and deep empathy for the farming community.

No standard Vercel dark mode or plain white templates
No fully transparent headers without backdrop blur

layout_sections.name: Full-Screen Opening Animation
layout_sections.description: An immersive agricultural landscape background overlay with logo reveal, Maharashtra wheat field silhouette, gold shimmer tagline reveal, and 'Skip Intro' option. Automatically fades out after 3.5 seconds or on skip click.

layout_sections.name: Sticky Glassmorphism Header
layout_sections.description: Blurred glass navigation bar (backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-900/85 or bg-cream-50/90) with JR Agro brand mark, EN/HI/MR language toggle, navigation links, quick call CTA, and dark mode switcher.

layout_sections.name: Kinetic Typography Hero
layout_sections.description: Masked line reveal with 'Growing Better. Growing Together.', high-definition Indian farmland backdrop, live yield impact counter metrics (+35% Crop Yield, 120,000+ Farmers Served, 15+ Maharashtra Districts), and primary CTA buttons.

layout_sections.name: Living Editorial Ribbon
layout_sections.description: Slowly drifting ribbon displaying key values: ORGANIC BIO-ENRICHER • MICRONUTRIENT SPECIALISTS • SOIL REJUVENATION • SANGLI MAHARASHTRA • TRUSTED BY 120K+ FARMERS • CERTIFIED QUALITY

layout_sections.name: About Us & Values Bento Grid
layout_sections.description: Asymmetric Bento grid showcasing JR Agro's legacy in Sangli, state-of-the-art laboratory testing, eco-sustainability, and farmer prosperity focus with rich photographic backgrounds.

layout_sections.name: Categorized Product Catalogue & Interactive Modal
layout_sections.description: Filter tabs (Bio-Fertilizers, Micronutrients, Water Soluble NPK, Soil Conditioners, Plant Growth Regulators), search bar, detailed product cards (composition, crop compatibility, dosage, benefits), product detail popup modal with WhatsApp order button.

layout_sections.name: Agricultural Crop Solutions & Calculator
layout_sections.description: Crop-specific nutrient schedules for Sugarcane, Grapes, Pomegranate, Wheat, Cotton, and Vegetables, alongside a Dosage & Soil Health Calculator.

layout_sections.name: Why Choose Us
layout_sections.description: 4-column feature section with custom icon badges highlighting Soil Chemistry Science, Instant Water Solubility, Eco-friendly Zero Residue, and Direct Field Agronomist Support.

layout_sections.name: Emotional Farmer Stories & Voice of Maharashtra
layout_sections.description: Heartfelt farmer spotlight with photos from Sangli, Kolhapur, and Satara districts, detailing before-and-after harvest improvements.

layout_sections.name: Certifications & Quality Badges
layout_sections.description: ISO 9001:2015, Organic Standard Certification, Govt. Approved R&D Lab, ICAR Compliant Badges with hover shimmer effect.

layout_sections.name: Dealer Locator & Regional Hubs
layout_sections.description: Interactive district filter (Sangli, Satara, Kolhapur, Solapur, Pune, Nashik) with dealer shop names, phone numbers, addresses, and instant 'Get Directions' / WhatsApp inquiry.

layout_sections.name: Enquiry Form & Location Map
layout_sections.description: Trilingual enquiry form with crop select dropdown, direct phone/WhatsApp details, and embedded Google Maps view of MIDC Kupwad, Sangli, Maharashtra.

layout_sections.name: FAQ Accordion
layout_sections.description: Collapsible accordion addressing common farmer queries regarding application dosage, mixing compatibility, organic certification, and bulk dealer ordering.

layout_sections.name: Grand Agriculture Footer
layout_sections.description: Rich dark green footer with massive stylized brand mark ('JR AGRO'), language switcher, quick links, emergency agronomist hotline, and copyright.

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll or Framer Motion scroll container

motion_and_effects.text_reveal: Masked overflow-hidden line slide-up animation for headlines

testing_requirements.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Lucide icons or Heroicons for sleek UI indicators (Leaf, Droplets, Sun, Award, MapPin, Phone, MessageSquare, ShieldCheck, ChevronRight, Search, X).
Ensure the EN/HI/MR language switcher dynamically updates all section titles, buttons, tags, and form placeholders.

Build the product catalogue with realistic Indian agrochemical products (e.g. Bio-NPK Growth Enhancer, Zinc Chelated Micronutrient 12%, Humic Acid Soil Activator, Micro-Nutrient Mix Grade II, Plant Revitalizer Solution) with detailed composition and dosage specs.
Include direct WhatsApp link trigger formatted as `https://wa.me/919876543210?text=Hello%20JR%20Agro%20Chemicals,%20I%20am%20interested%20in...`
Integrate Sonner for smooth toast feedback when submitting enquiry forms or switching languages.
Apply all test attributes (`data-testid`) consistently as listed under testing_requirements.
